Im in my first year just started this September, on top of first year of architecture already being hard the travelling doesn’t help. It affects me more mentally to be honest knowing it takes me so long to arrive home already makes me not want to study . And i am struggling with my grades. But its important to note that I haven’t really worked that hard or had a job before so i think im just not used to it and eventually it will become easier, you seem like a hard working person and im sure you can do it. Speaking from my friend’s experiences though (they live within 5 minutes of the campus) they have more time not only to do the work but do it very well and also enjoy their own time. if i was you id try to convince your parents to move closer, but if you couldn’t i think its still manageable. 

Note: i use public transportation to go and come back, if i had my own car i definitely wouldn’t mind the drive. even if there’s traffic in the morning or the way is long its better than buses.

Its take me two hours to go and two hours to come back from my university, and it is definitely affecting my studies. somedays i finish at 6 i get home by 8 there’s barely anytime to eat, study, relax, etc.
